shared_elements: animals in profile carved in low relief on a monolithic pillar
quadruped with elongated body and clawed limbs
multiple animals arranged in rows on a broad flat face
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief animals in strict profile — elongated quadrupeds with splayed clawed legs, serpentine forms and bird-headed creatures — distributed in stacked horizontal registers over the broad face of a monolithic pillar with a T-like upper element, and the carving convention (flat raised silhouette with almost no interior detail, small drilled eye, tail curling over the back) is the same in both. The differences are in the specific inventory and density: B adds a row of arcaded/loop motifs, a hatched band and a small anthropomorphic-headed figure, while A shows a sparser scatter of quadrupeds and reptiles without those bands.
